_doc: Provenance for docs/audio/src/. Maps each NEW family variant to the shipped clip it came
from, so the bake is traceable and re-runnable. Choices are driven by the measurements in
Design/audio.md §2 — where several old clips collapse into one new family, the sources with
the strongest transient (highest crest) win, because everything gets capped and normalised
anyway and only the attack survives that.
`null` = no source exists. Those are the authoring work-list; `sfx.py lint` reports them as

tick_1.why: 49 ms audible — the only correctly-short clip in the shipped set

tick_2.why: crest 22.8 dB, caps cleanly from 211 ms

tick_3.why: 102 ms clean single spike; reused off the deleted hover family

commit_1.why: crest 23.1 dB — best transient among the commit-class clips

commit_2.why: crest 26.0 dB, the highest in the set; 157 ms onset is trimmed away

error_1.why: direct; was -20.7 dBFS, the quietest clip in the set

hit_blunt.why: mace into shield+mail; deep thud, dull metallic edge. Generated 2026-07-27 (Jake consented).

hit_pierce.why: spear point through plate; tight metallic crack + brief scrape. Generated 2026-07-27.

hit_powder.why: matchlock muzzle blast over a powder thump. Generated 2026-07-27.

cast_fire.why: direct; crest 9.0 dB — expected to FAIL the transient check

riser_cleric.why: direct; 156 ms late onset is trimmed away

_dropped.preview_1: hover is silent by law (§5.1.1) — the family is deleted, not re-baked
_dropped.hall_ambience: D1: Jake cut the Hall ambience bed 2026-07-27
_dropped.route_1: 1.001 s of continuous sound for moving a resource; commit_2 covers the slot
_dropped.purchase_1: crest 14.8 dB, sustained — loses the commit slot to two better transients
